SELECT

    SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as total_cogs,
    SUM(ds.revenue_inr) - SUM(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) as gross_profit
FROM store.daily_sales ds
JOIN store.products p ON ds.sku = p.sku
WHERE ds.date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28';

    SUM(wo.units * p.cost_inr) as writeoff_cost
FROM store.write_offs wo

WHERE wo.date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28';

WITH bills_with_items AS (
  SELECT bill_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_atta,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sku_scanned = 'OIL-SUN-1L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_oil,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sku_scanned = 'DAL-TOOR-1KG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_dal
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
    AND sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-5KG', 'OIL-SUN-1L', 'DAL-TOOR-1KG')
  GROUP BY bill_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_bills_with_any,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_atta = 1 AND has_oil = 1 AND has_dal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as bills_with_all_three,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_atta = 1 AND has_oil = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as bills_atta_oil,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_atta = 1 AND has_dal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as bills_atta_dal,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_oil = 1 AND has_dal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as bills_oil_dal
FROM bills_with_items;
